agent_profiles.name: counterexample_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the relationship that survives the strongest counterexample to the hypothesis.

agent_profiles.name: surface_match
agent_profiles.instruction: Favor the relationship most directly supported by the literal premise wording, without adding outside assumptions.

agent_profiles.name: plausibility_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the relationship that best fits ordinary real-world expectations about the premise and hypothesis.
